newsitem.title: UK: One Brent cargo kept, one clocked - trade.
newsitem.headline: One Brent cargo kept, one clocked - trade.

text.p: Of the first two July Brent cargoes to turn wet on Monday one was kept and the other five o' clocked, traders said.
One of the July 1-3 loading cargoes was heard kept by Statsco while the other was clocked to Koch, traders said.
Brent cargoes are traded on a paper, or forward market until the 1700 London time deadline on the nearest trading day 15 days before their assigned loading date.
A trading company is clocked when it is left with a paper cargo which has turned physical after that deadline and therefore cannot be passed on as part of pre-sold paper cargo deals.
